title: Add QEMU boot and runtime smoke gate
purpose: Extend QEMU smoke from handoff-only evidence to boot plus packaged runtime availability evidence.
scope: Use E:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe as the default full smoke QEMU path.
Preserve AGENTD_HANDOFF_OK or accepted equivalent handoff marker.
Add runtime availability marker or command evidence from packaged runtime.
Record structured smoke result under Alpha evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Full QEMU smoke observes boot handoff.
Smoke proves runtime artifacts are available, not only a stub executable.
risk_notes: A QEMU check that only sees AGENTD_HANDOFF_OK cannot prove Distribution Alpha readiness by itself.
implementation_steps: Define the runtime marker or CLI probe that can run during smoke.
Wire the smoke result into Alpha evidence.
Run full QEMU smoke with the configured QEMU path.
failure_modes: Smoke passes from the old handoff stub only.
Runtime marker is not tied to rootfs manifest artifacts.

verification_matrix.expected: Boot handoff and runtime marker are observed

blocked_until: Runtime availability is proved from packaged artifacts.
